nodes.description: mapping(bytes32 => uint256) internal uintStorage in EternalStorage, holds limits, daily spent amounts and mediator balances
mapping(bytes32 => address) internal addressStorage, holds owner, bridge contract, mediator, token pairs
mapping(bytes32 => bool) internal boolStorage, used for reentrancy lock and initialization flags
mapping(bytes32 => int256) internal intStorage, stores forwarding lane rules
relayTokens(ERC677 token, address _receiver, uint256 _value) external in BasicMultiAMBErc20ToErc677
relayTokens(ERC677 token, uint256 _value) external, relays to msg.sender on the other side
Home onTokenTransfer(address _from, uint256 _value, bytes _data) public returns(bool), ERC677 callback
Foreign onTokenTransfer(address _from, uint256 _value, bytes _data) public returns(bool)
Home _relayTokens(ERC677 token, address _receiver, uint256 _value) internal with lock and transferFrom
Foreign _relayTokens internal using SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom and balance diff
Home bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer(ERC677 _token, address _from, address _receiver, uint256 _value) internal, charges fee, burns and passes message
Foreign bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer internal, registers token, checks limits and passes message
passMessage(ERC677 _token, address _from, address _receiver, uint256 _value) internal returns(bytes32)
Home executeActionOnBridgedTokens(address _token, address _recipient, uint256 _value) internal, charges fee and mints
Home executeActionOnFixedTokens(address _token, address _recipient, uint256 _value) internal, mints back failed transfer
Home handleBridgedTokens(ERC677 _token, address _recipient, uint256 _value) external onlyMediator
Home initialize(...) external onlyRelevantSender, initializes bridge params
deployAndHandleBridgedTokens(...) external onlyMediator, deploys TokenProxy and mints
fixFailedMessage(bytes32 _messageId) public onlyMediator in MultiTokenBridgeMediator
_distributeFee(bytes32 _feeType, address _token, uint256 _value) internal, loops reward accounts and transfers/mints fees
calculateFee(bytes32 _feeType, address _token, uint256 _value) public view returns(uint256)
getCurrentDay() public view returns(uint256) { return now / 1 days; }
withinLimit(address _token, uint256 _amount) public view returns(bool), outgoing daily limit check
withinExecutionLimit(address _token, uint256 _amount) public view returns(bool), incoming daily limit check
addTotalSpentPerDay(address _token, uint256 _day, uint256 _value) internal arithmetic on uintStorage
setDailyLimit(address _token, uint256 _dailyLimit) external onlyOwner
transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner
modifier onlyOwner() { require(msg.sender == owner()); _; }
modifier onlyMediator() { require(msg.sender == address(bridgeContract())); require(messageSender() == mediatorContractOnOtherSide()); _; }
claimTokens(address _token, address _to) external onlyIfUpgradeabilityOwner, withdraws unregistered tokens/native coins
Foreign _releaseTokens(address _token, address _recipient, uint256 _value) internal, unlocks or mints STAKE
fixMediatorBalance(address _token, address _receiver) external onlyIfUpgradeabilityOwner validAddress
Foreign executeActionOnBridgedTokens(address _token, address _recipient, uint256 _value) internal
msg.sender, the untrusted caller/token contract address
block.timestamp (now), used for the current day calculation
external call token.transferFrom / SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom pulling user tokens
external call ERC677(_token).transfer(nextAddr, feeToDistribute) to reward accounts
external call IBurnableMintableERC677Token(_token).mint(...) on home token
external call IBurnableMintableERC677Token(_token).burn(valueToBridge)
external call bridgeContract().requireToPassMessage / requireToConfirmMessage on the AMB bridge
address(this).call(abi.encodeWithSelector(UPGRADEABILITY_OWNER)) in onlyRelevantSender modifier
_token / token parameter of bridge entry points
_value amount parameter of bridge entry points
_receiver destination parameter
_from sender parameter in transfer callbacks
_data extra transfer data parameter used for alternative receiver
_addr reward address parameter of add/removeRewardAddress
valueToBridge local in home bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer
fee local variable holding distributed fee amount
balance local variable in _releaseTokens / mediatorBalance
lock() reentrancy guard local read from boolStorage slot

edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the ERC677 token contract that invokes the onTokenTransfer callback and is used as sender identity
msg.sender is the untrusted address whose tokens are pulled with transferFrom in _relayTokens
relayTokens is externally callable by any msg.sender
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against stored owner
onlyMediator modifier compares msg.sender against bridgeContract and the message sender
claimTokens is restricted via onlyIfUpgradeabilityOwner on msg.sender
fixMediatorBalance is restricted via onlyIfUpgradeabilityOwner on msg.sender
getCurrentDay derives the day from block.timestamp (now / 1 days), timestamp dependency for limits
withinLimit uses the current day quota to compute the next limit
withinExecutionLimit uses the current day executed quota
addTotalSpentPerDay is indexed by the current day returned by getCurrentDay
onTokenTransfer validates the bridged amount with withinLimit
onTokenTransfer adds the bridged amount to the daily spent counter
onTokenTransfer delegates the bridging action to bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer
onTokenTransfer reads the reentrancy lock flag from boolStorage via lock()
home _relayTokens validates the amount with withinLimit
home _relayTokens increments the daily spent counter
token.transferFrom triggers the ERC677 onTokenTransfer callback before state is fully settled (guarded by lock)
home _relayTokens sets and clears the lock flag held in boolStorage
home bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer charges the fee with _distributeFee
home bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer burns the bridged tokens
valueToBridge local receives _value and is reduced by the fee
valueToBridge is the amount passed to burn()
home bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer calls passMessage to notify the other side
passMessage performs the external AMB bridge call requireToPassMessage/requireToConfirmMessage
passMessage queries destinationLane which reads forwarding rules from intStorage
_distributeFee computes the total fee via calculateFee
_distributeFee transfers ERC677 tokens to reward addresses, a callback-capable external call
_distributeFee mints tokens to reward addresses for the foreign-to-home direction
the distributed fee amount is tracked in the fee local variable
handleBridgedTokens calls _handleBridgedTokens which checks withinExecutionLimit
handleBridgedTokens dispatches to the foreign executeActionOnBridgedTokens implementation
home executeActionOnBridgedTokens charges the foreign-to-home fee
home executeActionOnBridgedTokens mints the net amount to the recipient
home executeActionOnFixedTokens mints back tokens of a failed message
fixFailedMessage rolls back assets through executeActionOnFixedTokens
foreign executeActionOnBridgedTokens releases tokens via _releaseTokens
_releaseTokens performs SafeERC20 safeTransfer to unlock tokens
_releaseTokens mints extra STAKE tokens when the tracked balance is insufficient
_releaseTokens operand balance local is derived from mediatorBalance
fixMediatorBalance sends a message through the AMB bridge external call
foreign _relayTokens safeTransferFrom triggers the ERC677 callback which re-enters onTokenTransfer
foreign _relayTokens performs bridge actions with the measured balance difference
foreign onTokenTransfer delegates bridging to bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer
foreign bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer calls the AMB bridge to pass the message
foreign bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer increments the daily spent counter
foreign bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer validates the amount with withinLimit
deployAndHandleBridgedTokens finishes with executeActionOnBridgedTokens
relayTokens forwards to the internal _relayTokens
relayTokens(token,value) forwards to _relayTokens with msg.sender as receiver
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier
setDailyLimit is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier
the onlyRelevantSender check uses a low level address(this).call to detect proxy usage before initialize
addTotalSpentPerDay reads and writes the daily spent amount in uintStorage
_relayTokens interacts with state stored in addressStorage (bridge, mediator addresses)
passMessage lane choice depends on forwarding rules stored in intStorage
_token parameter feeds the home onTokenTransfer logic
_value parameter feeds limit checks and daily counters
_receiver parameter selects the destination of bridged tokens
_from parameter is used as the reward address check and fallback receiver
_data parameter is decoded by chooseReceiver for alternative receiver support
_addr reward address is a member of the list iterated by _distributeFee
the lock local returned by lock() guards the onTokenTransfer body against double execution

normalization_plan.reason: the _token parameter is materialized as the msg.sender token contract inside onTokenTransfer
the _value parameter only exists through the onTokenTransfer / _relayTokens bridging flow
the _receiver parameter is consumed when the bridge action is dispatched from onTokenTransfer
the _from parameter is directly used by onTokenTransfer to choose the effective receiver
the _data parameter is decoded by chooseReceiver during the onTokenTransfer flow
the _addr reward address parameter is only relevant as an entry of the reward list iterated in _distributeFee
valueToBridge is a local temporary inside home bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer
fee is a local temporary of the _distributeFee flow
balance is a local temporary of _releaseTokens used to adjust the mediator balance
the lock local is a transient reentrancy-guard value only meaningful within onTokenTransfer
